query: WITH new AS (INSERT INTO messaging.email_outbox (idempotency_key, template_id, recipient_id, recipient_kind, subject_ids, class, subject, html, plain, not_before, queued_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, CASE WHEN $6 THEN 'bulk' ELSE 'notice' END, $7, $8, $9, $10, $10) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id) SELECT id AS "id!", true AS "new!" FROM new UNION ALL SELECT id, false FROM messaging.email_outbox WHERE idempotency_key = $1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM new)
